experiences.name: Praia da Marinha Coastal Hike & Swim
experiences.description: Explore one of the Algarve's most stunning beaches, known for its dramatic golden limestone cliffs, sea caves, and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Hike the clifftop trail and descend to the secluded cove for a refreshing swim among natural rock arches.

experiences.name: Algarve Wine & Vineyard Tour
experiences.description: Visit local wineries in the Lagoa DOC wine region, the heart of Algarve wine production. Sample regional whites, reds, and the famous Algarve medronho brandy, paired with local cheeses and charcuterie, while learning about the unique terroir from passionate local winemakers.

experiences.name: Benagil Sea Cave Kayak Tour
experiences.description: Paddle through the iconic Benagil Cave, one of the world's most beautiful sea caves, accessible only by water. A guided kayak tour takes you through hidden grottos, sea arches, and secluded beaches along the stunning Algarve coastline that are unreachable on foot.

experiences.name: Sagres Sunset & Fortaleza de Sagres Visit
experiences.description: Visit the historic Fortaleza de Sagres, the legendary fortress at the southwestern tip of Europe where Henry the Navigator planned his great sea voyages. Explore the windswept promontory, the mysterious wind compass, and stay for a breathtaking Atlantic sunset that feels like the edge of the world.

experiences.name: Quinta dos Vales Wine Estate Experience
experiences.description: Spend an afternoon at one of the Algarve's most celebrated wine estates, featuring award-winning wines and an open-air sculpture park. Enjoy a guided tasting of their premium reds and whites, stroll through the vineyards, and admire monumental sculptures set against a backdrop of rolling hills and cork oak trees.
